# Recipe contribution

Read the [contribution guide](https://github.com/RagingRedRiot/cued/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md),
including the AI-assisted contribution policy.

## Purpose and prerequisites

Describe what the recipe does and the tools, versions, and local configuration
it requires.

## Commands and side effects

Explain the success and failure paths and any files created, changed, or deleted.

## Verification in cued

Describe how you exercised the success and failure paths in cued, including
tool versions and expected results. Note any paths or notification behavior
that you did not verify.

Author the TOML outside cued and verify it in cued; we do not recommend
contributing job exports. Do not include secrets or personal paths.
